label: Kimura fixation probability of a mutant allele
statement_en: The probability that a mutant allele eventually fixes in a finite population depends on its initial frequency, its selective advantage and the effective population size, and equals its initial frequency when it is neutral.

hypotheses.name: kimura-fixation-probability#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: Neutral case only (s = 0). Kimura 1962 with selection in the diffusion limit is not formalised.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
